messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that either falls on a Friday or a Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend, giving you a three‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if on weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Provinces/territories where it applies |
|---|---------|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------|----------------------------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** | Observed **Mon Jan 2** | **Dec 30 – Jan 2** | All provinces & territories |
| 2 | Family Day | **Mon Feb 20** | — | **Feb 18 – 20** | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, and a few others |
| 3 | Good Friday | **Fri Apr 7** | — | **Apr 7 – 9** | All provinces & territories |
| 4 | Victoria Day | **Mon May 22** | — | **May 20 – 22** | All provinces & territories |
| 5 | Canada Day | **Sat Jul 1** | Observed **Mon Jul 3** | **Jul 1 – 3** | All provinces & territories |
| 6 | Labour Day | **Mon Sep 4** | — | **Sep 2 – 4** | All provinces & territories |
| 7 | Thanksgiving | **Mon Oct 9** | — | **Oct 7 – 9** | All provinces & territories |
| 8 | Remembrance Day | **Sat Nov 11** | Observed **Mon Nov 13** | **Nov 11 – 13** | All provinces & territories |
| 9 | Christmas | **Mon Dec 25** | — | **Dec 23 – 25** | All provinces & territories |
|10 | Boxing Day | **Tue Dec 26** | — | — (no long weekend) | All provinces & territories |

### Quick notes

* **Family Day** is a provincial holiday; the date and whether it creates a long weekend depends on the province.  
  * Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, and a few others observe it on the third Monday in February (2023: Feb 20).  
  * Some provinces (e.g., British Columbia) have a different holiday (e.g., “BC Day”) on the same day.

* **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17) is a statutory holiday in Ontario, New Brunswick, and a few other provinces, but it does **not** create a long weekend in 2023 because it fell on a Friday (so you’d have Fri‑Sat‑Sun, but the holiday itself is only one day).

* **Boxing Day** is a holiday in all provinces, but because it fell on a Tuesday in 2023, it didn’t extend a weekend.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific details or want to include other statutory holidays, let me know!
